title: Empower Brands Recalls Power XL Dual Basket Air Fryers Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The plastic U-Channel connector used to optionally combine the two food baskets inside of the air fryers can break during use, posing a burn hazard. Units: About 319,000.

title: Kubota Tractor Recalls Utility Vehicles Due to Crash and Collision Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: Components of the steering shaft/steering system could have been improperly assembled which can lead to loss of control, posing crash and collision hazards. Units: About 3,170 (In addition, about 119 were sold in Canada).

title: Polaris Industries Recalls Ranger XP Kinetic Recreational Off-Road Vehicles (ROVs) Due to Crash Hazard
summary: Pressing the brake and throttle pedals simultaneously can deactivate the throttle. If the brake is then released, the vehicle can move and the throttle can still be deactivated, posing a crash hazard and risk of serious injury. Units: About 2,000 (In addition, about 175 were sold in Canada).

title: Polaris Industries Recalls RZR 200 Youth Recreational Off-Road Vehicles (ROVs) Due to Crash Hazard and Risk of Serious Injury
summary: The steering system can lock up while in use, posing a crash hazard and risk of serious injury to children. Units: About 19,000 (In addition, about 950 were sold in Canada).

title: Room & Board Recalls Griffin Duo Bunk Beds Due to Risk of Collapse, Fall and Injury Hazards; Sold Exclusively at Room & Board
summary: Some Griffin Duo Bunk Beds failed to be properly assembled by Room & Board with set screws installed into the side rail brackets at the time of delivery. Brackets lacking set screws can create a collapse risk, and fall and injury hazards. Units: About 500.

title: Savvy Rest Recalls Quilted Cotton Mattress Pads Due to Fire Hazard and Violation of Federal Mattress Pad Flammability Standard
summary: The recalled quilted cotton mattress pads fail to meet the mandatory federal flammability standard for mattress pads, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 84.

title: Traeger Pellet Grills Recalls Flat Top Propane Grills Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The burner control knob can be incorrectly labeled, which can result in the grill being unintentionally left on, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 37,000.

title: Weatherbeeta USA Recalls Collegiate Horse-Riding Saddles Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The saddle's rivet or stirrup bar can break, causing the rider to fall, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 2,300.

title: Bugaboo Recalls Dragonfly Seat Strollers Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: In "parent-facing" mode, the backrest of the seat can move downward, placing the infant in a negative recline. In this situation, an unrestrained infant could tumble from the seat, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 1,000 (In addition, about 200 were sold in Canada).

title: Bunkhouse and Lotsa LITES! Mini String Lights Recalled Due to Burn and Fire Hazards; Imported by DM Merchandising (Recall Alert)
summary: The bulbs can overheat when the string lights are plugged directly into an outlet, presenting burn and fire hazards. Units: About 34,600.

title: Ergodyne Recalls Squids Wire Tool Attachments with Screw Gate Tool Tails Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The wire tool attachment can break when dropped while tethered to a tool exceeding two pounds, posing an injury hazard to bystanders. Units: About 16,570 (In addition, about 790 were sold in Canada).

title: Mary Meyer Recalls Bubba Bull Plush Toys Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The eyes of the plush toys can break off, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 1,950.

title: Moonsea Pack and Play Mattresses Recalled Due to Suffocation Hazard for Infants; Violation to the Federal Safety Regulation for Crib Mattresses; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com by Moonseasleep (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled mattresses violate multiple provisions of the federal safety regulation for crib mattresses, including the thickness test and missing warnings and labels. The product poses a suffocation hazard to infants. Units: About 11,000.

title: Nap Queen Maxima Hybrid Mattresses Recalled by Adven Group Due to Fire Hazard; Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The mattresses fail to meet the mandatory federal flammability standard for mattresses, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 1,540.

title: Oreck Discover Upright Vacuums Recalled by TTI Floor Care Due to Electrical Shock Hazard
summary: The vacuum's electric cord plug prong can detach and remain in an electrical outlet when the vacuum is unplugged. This poses an electrical shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 6,200.

summary: The bottom portion of the recalled baby rattles can detach, posing choking and/or ingestion hazards. Units: About 1,380.

summary: The hose end nozzle clip can dislodge and allow the cleaning solution to spray on users, posing a risk of skin and eye irritation and other injuries. Units: About 2.7 million.

summary: The recalled blenders can overheat or catch fire and the blender blades can break off, posing fire and laceration hazards to consumers. Units: About 4.8 million (in addition, about 117,000 were sold in Canada).

summary: The lithium battery in the electric start system can overheat, posing a burn hazard. Units: About 2,930.

title: DGL Group Recalls Hover-1 Helix Hoverboards Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The recalled hoverboard's lithium-ion battery can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 25,000.

summary: The top and bottom of the internal inverter boards of the power stations can overheat, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 3,800 (In addition, about 164 were sold in Canada).

summary: The window's sash can detach from the frame and fall, posing an injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 12,000 (In addition, about 305 were sold in Canada and about 10 were sold in Mexico).
